Class LocomotiveDTO

java.lang.Object
dto.LocomotiveDTO
public class LocomotiveDTO extends Object
A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a locomotive along with its properties such as model, fuel type, max speed, start and end year of operations, price, fuel cost per 100km and maintenance cost per year. This class provides methods to access the locomotive's metadata.
